summary: This directory centralizes the testing infrastructure for the routing subsystem, specifically focusing on validating AI model route configurations and execution flows to ensure proper traffic direction and handling of model-specific requests.
responsibilities: Verify correct routing logic for AI models
Test the execution context of routed requests
Ensure service-level interaction with routing mechanisms
relationships: The route service consumes model route configurations to determine the appropriate path for incoming requests.
The execution utility facilitates running requests within a defined model route context to isolate and test routing behavior.
designDecisions: Collocation of tests with their respective service logic for improved maintainability
Use of isolated test environments for validating model routing behaviors
